name: @refarm.dev/quality-checker-ref
description: Reference quality:v1 checker — a pure-compute WASM component (world quality-checker) proving the sovereign checker boundary end-to-end.

scripts.build:transpile: jco transpile dist/refarm_quality_checker_ref.wasm -o pkg --name quality_checker_ref --no-wasi-shim --instantiation async
scripts.build:component: node ../../scripts/ci/cargo-run.mjs --copy wasm32-wasip1/release/refarm_quality_checker_ref.wasm dist/refarm_quality_checker_ref.wasm component build --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && jco transpile dist/refarm_quality_checker_ref.wasm -o pkg --name quality_checker_ref --no-wasi-shim --instantiation async
